title: Grilled Shrimp Fajitas
description: Grilled shrimp and shiitake mushrooms served with a side of crunchy slaw and warm flour tortillas. A flavorful and spicy Mexican dish.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil and cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add another tablespoon of oil to the skillet and cook the sliced shiitake mushrooms for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add the sliced red onion to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until caramelized.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing a portion of the cooked shrimp and mushrooms onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of crunchy slaw.
Serve immediately and garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
